name: unsafe fn from_parts (ptr : NonNull < T > , length : usize , capacity : usize) -> Self
rule: The first `length` elements pointed to by `ptr` must be properly initialized values of type `T`.
api: impl < T > alloc::vec::Vec < T > { unsafe fn from_parts (ptr : core::ptr::non_null::NonNull < T > , length : usize , capacity : usize) -> Self }
expression: The requirement is not expressible in this DSL: `ptr.$mem.pointee.valid` covers only one `T`, and no indexing or offset operation can observe the remaining elements.
